sell.reason: Treu is the sale, and he is the only one. He is the sole funding leg needed: the instant sale to Kickbase clears the entire debt on its own, takes the squad to eleven, and leaves a legal 5-3-2 behind it, so no replacement has to land first. On merit he is the right body to lose — the lowest scoring average in the squad, and the mean flatters him because his matchday returns are lopsided, with a median well below the average. He is also the only outfielder in the squad who is not an ever-present: three starts and one substitute appearance across the four matchdays played, and roughly seven-tenths of the available minutes. The news check confirms the case rather than complicating it. He is fit, with a green fitness marker and no status flag, so this is not an availability sale. But the right-back duel with Kuebler remains unresolved: the most recent dated Freiburg reporting, from early September, has the coach still describing the contest as close, and the same-day feature framing is explicit that a regular starting place is something he has yet to secure. Nothing more recent contradicts it. One honest caveat: his market value is rising briskly, so an instant sale at today's value forgoes that drift. Georg optimises for points, the debt has to close, and the drift is not worth the exposure. Deman is expressly NOT sold. The structure that would have required him died when the Mwene buy was reversed, and pulling the offer voids his conditional block outright. He is fit, an ever-present, rising, and a keeper.
